subject.name_en: Chengdu Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum

text_zh: 杜甫草堂博物馆官方参观页提供实名预约购票，最多提前14天。14天是可购票窗口，不是必须提前14天；本条未核定普通散客是否必须提前预约，应另查馆方最新说明。学生集体免费参观的提前5个工作日规则不适用于普通散客。馆方开放时间页只列每日开闭馆时段、未列每周闭馆日，同站学生集体参观细则把参观安排在周一、周二；四川在线2025年2月采访报道称该馆全年无休，但按本库来源分级，新闻报道不能单独支撑闭馆规则，因此每周是否有固定闭馆日本条未核定；重大节假日延时、临时闭馆及局部展厅安排行前查馆方通知。
text_en: The Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum visitor page offers real-name ticket booking up to 14 days ahead. This is a maximum booking window, not a 14-day minimum. This entry does not confirm mandatory advance booking for ordinary individual visitors; check current museum guidance. The separate five-working-day rule for free student-group visits does not apply to ordinary individuals. The museum’s opening-hours page lists daily opening times without a weekly closing day, and its student-group rules schedule visits on Mondays and Tuesdays; a February 2025 Sichuan Online report describes the museum as open throughout the year, but under this catalogue’s source tiers a news report cannot on its own establish a closing rule, so whether there is a fixed weekly closing day is not confirmed here. Check museum notices for extended holiday hours, temporary closures and individual galleries before travelling.

subject.name_zh: 成都熊猫基地6号大熊猫别墅区域
subject.name_en: Chengdu Panda Base – No.6 Giant Panda Villa Area

text_zh: 成都熊猫基地的6号大熊猫别墅区域正在试行周一轮休，国家法定节假日除外。本条仅指这个子设施，不表示整个基地周一闭园；临时调整查基地公告。本设施是否另需预约及提前窗口尚未单独核定，不能把unknown当作免预约。
text_en: No.6 Giant Panda Villa Area inside Chengdu Panda Base has a trial Monday rest closure, except on statutory public holidays. This applies only to the named facility, not the whole Base. Check Base notices for temporary changes. Any separate facility reservation requirement and advance window are unconfirmed here; unknown does not mean reservation-free.

subject.name_zh: 成都熊猫基地熊猫美术馆
subject.name_en: Chengdu Panda Base – Panda Art Museum

text_zh: 成都熊猫基地内的熊猫美术馆周一闭馆维护，国家法定节假日除外。本条仅指这个子设施，不表示整个基地周一闭园；临时调整查基地公告。本设施是否另需预约及提前窗口尚未单独核定，不能把unknown当作免预约。
text_en: The Panda Art Museum inside Chengdu Panda Base closes for maintenance on Mondays, except on statutory public holidays. This applies only to the named facility, not the whole Base. Check Base notices for temporary changes. Any separate facility reservation requirement and advance window are unconfirmed here; unknown does not mean reservation-free.
